purpose: Teach: デイトレード/圏内/屈指/約款/朗報/物的/司書/仕掛ける

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、研究者のデイトレード傾向を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Ren, you've covered researcher day-trading patterns in your paper.
lines.style: Even, measured tone. Acknowledgment more than praise. Brief pause on the name. This is a factual opening — Hiroshi is setting the terrain before the work begins.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。学会の発表圏内にいる研究者と連携します
lines.en: Yes. I'm coordinating with researchers who are positioned to present at the conference.
lines.style: Respectful, straightforward. Slight hesitation after 'Yes' — gathering his thoughts before responding. No rushing. The tone of someone taking an assignment seriously.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、業界屈指の論文を目標にしろ
lines.en: Ren, aim for one of the top papers in the field.
lines.style: Firm, direct. Not unkind. The weight of expectation landed clearly, quietly. No room for misunderstanding — this is a standard being set, not a suggestion.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。研究契約の約款を確認しました
lines.en: Yes. I've reviewed the research contract terms.
lines.style: Precise, formal. A small note of competence — he's done the legwork. Measured pace. Not seeking approval, just reporting readiness.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、学会から朗報があれば真っ先に報告しろ
lines.en: Ren, if the conference comes back with good news, report to me first.
lines.style: Quiet authority. The priority is being established without needing to be repeated. Hiroshi's eyes steady on Ren. A moment of trust given and expected to be understood.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。物的サンプルを増やします
lines.en: Yes. I'll increase the physical sample size.
lines.style: Grounded, immediate. Ren is responding to the priority — not just acknowledging but already thinking forward. Calm determination underneath.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、図書館の司書に資料収集を頼め
lines.en: Ren, ask the librarian to help you gather source materials.
lines.style: Practical instruction. Matter-of-fact. Hiroshi is clearing obstacles — this is mentorship through removal of friction, not decoration.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。共同研究を仕掛ける提案を持って行きます
lines.en: Yes. I'll bring a proposal to initiate a collaborative research partnership.
lines.style: Quiet resolution in the closing. Ren is not just taking direction — he's moving. Slightly firmer than before. The 'close' carries him toward action, not away from it.
